info.title: NMM Distributor API
info.description: Distributor APIs to register, cancel, suspend NMM Installs and retrieve usage information. Contact nmm.support@getnerdio.com to request APIKey and access to Mothership portal.

400.description: Bad request. Invalid parameters or invalid parameter.

422.description: Unprocessable entity. Azure subscription ID you specified is not valid or may not be a GUID.

500.description: Internal server error. The information supplied in the parameters is incorrect.

409.description: Conflict. Another distributor has already registered NMM Installs by partner you are trying to register.
